pages.text: The Materializer has 3 item slots (the catalyst is one) and a radius upgrade slot. It makes items from entropy. Its recipes need a level: dragon breath a charged chunk, the others a critical chunk.

Start mode: a button switches between auto (starts when the inputs are in) and manual (waits for the Start button). Manual is the default. It lets you build the structure first.$(br2)Ghost preview: a button shows the structure as ghost blocks, above the machine and in front of it. It is a guide only. Build anywhere in the area: 7x7 blocks around the machine, up to 5 blocks high, not in the machine column.

At 80 % of a run, a world event can trigger. If the structure is not complete, the run fails and the inputs are lost. The event uses the structure up: each rune block becomes a purpur block.$(br2)Dragon breath (50 %): 4 glass bottles + 1 entropy shard + catalyst give 4 dragon breath (150 entropy).$(br)Shulker shell (75 %): 4 purpur blocks + 1 ender pearl + catalyst (300 entropy).$(br)Dragon scales (100 %): 1 infused ingot + 4 dragon breath + catalyst give 2 dragon scales (300 entropy).
